extracted.intended_audience: researchers, research administrators, and institutions looking for JST funding opportunities and program information
extracted.subtask_description: Locate and review Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) program announcements, open calls, deadlines, and office contact/role information to identify appropriate funding opportunities and international collaboration programs. The page aggregates news, program calls (e.g., CREST, PRESTO, ACT-X, FOREST), and descriptions of JST overseas offices.
